activity-date.narrative: Results from Oct 2025 - 2028: - SRHR youth in rural and peri-urban settings of Kisumu and Kisii have increased awareness and gain tools, capacity and strategies to organise and demand for affirming SRH services within public healthcare facilities. - Healthcare service providers within rural and peri-urban settings of Kisumu and Kisii counties have improved responsiveness and provide unlimited and affirming SRH care to SRHR youth. - Duty bearers have better understanding of SRHR lived realities around SRH access and enact affirming laws at county.
